name: Tasmanian adult travel concession
summary: Half-price public transport fares in Tasmania for Health Care Card holders and eligible full-time university and TasTAFE students.
key: A discount of 50% off the full fare.
who: Holders of an eligible concession card, including the Services Australia Health Care Card
Eligible full-time adult students at university, TasTAFE or Tasmanian College of English carrying student ID
catches: A further 20% discount is applied when using a smartcard like Greencard, Transportme, or a 10-trip ticket, where available.
Fares are free for everyone until 30 June 2027.

evidence.quote: A discount of 50% off the full fare.
Eligible adult students (full-time students attending secondary college, university, TasTAFE or Tasmanian College of English. Must carry relevant student identification).

evidence.claim: Health Care Card shown as an eligible card
